title: Terms of Use
description: The terms for using Deal Notes: information only, no warranties on third-party products or prices, and how links to other sites work.
intro: By using Deal Notes you agree to these terms. They are short because the site is simple: we publish information, and you decide what to buy.

sections.h: Is the information on this site advice?
sections.answer: No. Guides and news are general information to help you research purchases. Check details such as specs, compatibility and safety warnings with the seller or maker before you buy.
No. We do not sell anything. Prices, stock and offers are set by Amazon and other sellers and can change at any time.

sections.h: What about links to other sites?
sections.answer: We link to sources and stores we think are useful, but we do not control them and are not responsible for their content, products or policies.
You can quote short passages with a link back. Please do not republish whole pages.
The site is provided as is. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for losses from using the site or from products bought through links on it.
